_comment: Editable best-practice thresholds + reference links for the Nerdio Health Check. Tune here without touching code. Severities: Required (supportability/security must-fix), Recommended (best-practice), Optional (nice-to-have). 'Pass' and 'Info'/'Manual' are non-issues.

version._knownLatestVersion_help: Optional. Set to the current GA NME version (e.g. 7.7.3.4) to enable the N/N-1 supportability check. Leave blank to report version as informational only. Nerdio releases roughly every 8 weeks — update this when you refresh the tool.

score._help: Overall health score = 100 - (weighted open findings per host pool x deductionPerUnit), clamped 0-100. Manual/Info/Pass do not deduct. Tune weights and deduction to taste.

manualChecks.title: Log Analytics counters & polling rate
manualChecks.note: Set User Input Delay Per Process polling to 300s+ (often 80-91% of ingestion cost). Not exposed by the REST API - review in NME and capture the monthly saving.

manualChecks.title: Reserved Instance Analytics
manualChecks.note: Review RI Analytics (Autoscale > RI Analytics, last 30 days). For each 1 CPU-month of steady usage a reserved instance pays off. Not in the REST API.

manualChecks.title: 30-day auto-scale history (CPU/RAM utilisation)
manualChecks.note: Check Autoscale > History (last 30 days). Aim for 60-80% on the higher of CPU/RAM. Below 60% = consider smaller VMs or more sessions per host. Telemetry, not in the REST API.

manualChecks.title: Insights dashboards (Health, AVD, Workspaces, W365)
manualChecks.note: Review component health statuses, connection-health dashboard, login duration, FSLogix metrics, named-user vs MAU, and W365 dashlets. Visual telemetry, not in the REST API.

manualChecks.title: Azure Monitor / AVD Insights enablement
manualChecks.note: Verify Azure Monitor Insight is enabled, saving to a LAW, with 'Use Azure Monitor Agent' checked. Confirm in NME / Azure.

manualChecks.title: Host pools with zero session hosts
manualChecks.note: This tool derives host pools from session-host records, so a pool with no hosts is not discoverable via the REST API. Confirm in the NME console that no empty pools were missed.

manualChecks.title: Azure Capacity Extender (Premium)
manualChecks.note: If regional capacity/quota is a risk, review Azure Capacity Extender to allow alternative VM SKUs. Ensure sufficient quota for the additional SKUs. Not cleanly exposed by the REST API.
